items.Sentence: The septic tanks at the existing areas will be replaced and the new septic tanks at the Historic Comfort Center and the Ranger office will have capacities of 15,000 gallons and 2,000 gallons, respectively.
New 6-inch PVC pipe will convey effluent from all three new septic tanks to a 20,000 gallon dosing tank for flow equalization.
The effluent will be discharged from the dosing tank into a new 3-acre leachfield southwest of the South Entrance Station...
Each cell is equipped with its own 6-outlet automatic, SCADA monitored distributing valve...
